mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and boosting expected equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS remaining below 1% over the horizon, or if other macro factors dominate the return movement.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in unemployment rate above 9.5% indicates weak labor market conditions, reducing growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5 percentage points from current value (9.1% to 9.6%)
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite UNRATE crossing the threshold, or if the rate decline reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate combined with rising demand (GDP growth) creates a favorable environment for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <30% of triggered instances despite the combined signal, or if other macroeconomic factors negate the effect within the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of elevated unemployment above 9.5%, weak labor market conditions reduce corporate growth prospects, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in <50% of triggered instances despite UNRATE remaining above 9.5%, or if the unemployment rate begins to decline before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index above 95 signals robust manufacturing activity, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <40% of triggered instances despite INDPRO rising above 95, or if supply shocks offset the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When demand metrics like HOUST (units) exceed 600, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in <30% of triggered instances despite HOUST crossing the threshold, or if the surge is temporary.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate paired with rising GDP demand creates a dual accommodative signal, amplifying equity valuation growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <25% of triggered instances despite the combined signal, or if monetary policy tightens unexpectedly.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of monetary tightening (federal funds rate rising above 0.15%), investors anticipate higher inflation and reduced growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in <40% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS rising above 0.15%, or if the tightening reverses prematurely.
